title: Text Diff Engine
description: Build a text diff engine implementing the Myers diff algorithm with patch generation and application.

steps.title: Implement LCS (Longest Common Subsequence)
steps.description: Build a function that computes the Longest Common Subsequence of two strings using dynamic programming. Create a 2D table where DP[i][j] stores the LCS length for prefixes. Print both the LCS length and the actual LCS string.
hints: Initialize a (m+1) x (n+1) table with zeros, fill by comparing characters
When chars match, take DP[i-1][j-1] + 1; otherwise take max of DP[i-1][j] and DP[i][j-1]
Backtrack through the table from bottom-right to reconstruct the LCS string

verification.successMessage: LCS function returns correct length and string for sample inputs
verification.failureMessage: LCS output missing length or content

steps.title: Build Myers diff algorithm
steps.description: Implement the Myers diff algorithm that finds the shortest edit script (SES) between two sequences. Use the greedy snake-based approach. Print the edit operations as a list of insertions, deletions, and equal elements with their positions.
hints: Model the problem as finding a path in the edit graph from (0,0) to (N,M)
Use diagonals tracked in a V array where V[k] stores the furthest x reached on diagonal k
Each snake extends along matching characters; non-matching steps are inserts or deletes

verification.successMessage: Myers algorithm produces correct edit script with insert/delete operations
verification.failureMessage: Edit operations missing from diff output

steps.title: Add line-by-line diff
steps.description: Extend the Myers algorithm to compare multi-line strings. Split input text into arrays of lines and compute the diff. Print added lines with a `+` prefix, removed lines with a `-` prefix, and context lines with a space prefix.
hints: Split strings by newline, keeping line endings for later reconstruction
Group consecutive same-type operations into hunks for cleaner output
Print line numbers alongside the +/- markers for reference

verification.successMessage: Line-by-line diff shows added and removed lines with +/- correctly
verification.failureMessage: Line diff output missing + or - prefixes

steps.title: Implement patch generation
steps.description: Create a `generatePatch()` function that produces unified diff format output, similar to `git diff`. Include hunks with line ranges, context lines, and the @@ header. Print the formatted patch string.
hints: Each hunk header follows the format @@ -start,count +start,count @@
Include 3 lines of context before and after each change group
Track original and new line numbers separately as you walk through hunks

verification.successMessage: Patch output is valid unified diff format with hunk headers
verification.failureMessage: Patch missing @@ hunk headers or line range markers

steps.title: Add patch application
steps.description: Implement `applyPatch(original, patch)` that applies edit instructions to the original text and returns the modified result. Handle overlapping hunks by tracking offset adjustments. Print the resulting text after applying the patch.
hints: Parse the unified diff hunks to extract line ranges and operations
Apply edits in reverse order (bottom-up) to avoid offset corruption
Track how many lines were added/removed to adjust subsequent hunk positions

verification.successMessage: Patch applies cleanly and produces expected output text
verification.failureMessage: Patch application output does not match expected result

steps.title: Build word-level diff
steps.description: Enhance the diff engine to show inline word changes within lines. Split changed lines into words and run the Myers algorithm on words. Print word-level highlights using brackets or color markers around changed words.
hints: Split lines on word boundaries using regex or whitespace punctuation splitting
Run the existing Myers diff on word arrays to find insert/delete/equal at word granularity
Render output by wrapping deleted words in [- -] and added words in {+ +} markers

verification.successMessage: Word-level diff shows inline changes with proper highlights
verification.failureMessage: Word-level diff markers missing from output
